subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Whispers of the Cryptid
email_body:
Hi Chrissy,

Your collection Whispers of the Cryptid caught my attention because it sends ordinary people into encounters with the Jersey Devil, Mothman, Bigfoot and the Flatwoods Monster, with settings like the Pine Barrens and Loch Ness. Writing horror since the age of fourteen and now bringing it to cryptid legends is a story readers will want to hear.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Whispers of the Cryptid is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Whispers of the Cryptid best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
